newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover shrank to 1.052 billion yuan from 4.964 billion yuan with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said turnover fell as both state-run banks and non-bank financial institions cut their volume after heavy trading on Wednesday.
Market talk that the central bank will cut bank reserve ratios resurfaced, keeping some institutions out of the market. But an official with the central bank said there was no such plan as of now.

Traders said they expected rates to move around current levels in the short-term. But if talk of a cut in bank reserve ratios proves true, banks would be flush with funds to lend on the market and rates would ease over the medium term.
